mobileScope: Mobile catalogue discovery, search, synonym/typo/multilingual retrieval, favorites/recents, folder/tree and facet navigation, user-setting transfer, and Android accessibility. This is research, not an implementation or product-scope approval.

mobileRemainder.task: Test search with a real personal catalogue and record its size instead of assuming target cardinality.
mobileRemainder.why_remaining: Competitor cases include enterprise scales and one 10k-comment issue, not representative personal-activity data.
mobileRemainder.ready_when: Target users' item counts and search journeys are observed without installing competitors or importing private data without permission.

mobileRemainder.task: Prototype mobile start page with quick action, Favorite, Recent, global Search/All and optional Browse.
mobileRemainder.why_remaining: Feature evidence exists; no user interaction test has compared visual layouts or choice friction.
mobileRemainder.ready_when: First-run and returning-user tasks complete with measured taps/time and no required taxonomy setup.

mobileRemainder.task: Decide favorite, recent, pinned-detail and whole-entry shortcut semantics and how each is serialized.
mobileRemainder.why_remaining: Competitor vocabulary and existing core snapshot must be reconciled with a named accepted shortcut model; proposed limit/order and actual UX are unvalidated.
mobileRemainder.ready_when: Product spec states object type, persistence, deduplication, ordering, and transfer behavior for each shortcut.
mobileRemainder.status: Analytical contract is now specified as recommendation; still open for product acceptance and UI/API mapping. Item Favorite, Recent and Detail Pin are not documented core features; preset field-level behavior needs verification.

mobileRemainder.task: Benchmark local search on low-end Android hardware using long names and 100/1k/10k synthetic catalogues.
mobileRemainder.why_remaining: No app was installed and no benchmark was run.
mobileRemainder.ready_when: Measured p50/p95 query latency, keystroke loss, and result-render behavior meet thresholds selected by the product team.

mobileRemainder.task: Select supported UI locales and ask speakers to review case, accents, Unicode normalization and aliases.
mobileRemainder.why_remaining: General Unicode/platform guidance cannot decide user-visible equivalence in each language.
mobileRemainder.ready_when: Fixtures and false-positive cases are approved per supported language before fuzzy/diacritic matching ships.

mobileRemainder.task: Prototype accessible search/reorder and run TalkBack, Switch Access/Voice Access and keyboard tests.
mobileRemainder.why_remaining: No tracker-specific a11y user report or live app audit was available.
mobileRemainder.ready_when: Every action works without drag-only interaction; focus, result paths, 48dp targets and state are verified.

mobileRemainder.task: Specify and test catalogue-only export/import separate from activity history.
mobileRemainder.why_remaining: The current JSON v2 restore replaces the dataset; no catalog-only bundle or previewed per-ID adapter has been implemented or tested on another device.
mobileRemainder.ready_when: A previewed portable schema handles new device, duplicate names, edits and undo without silently remapping existing history.
mobileRemainder.status: Catalog-only schema and deterministic merge policy proposed; feature/round-trip remains open.

mobileRemainder.task: Review the current state of 2020 Clockify picker feature requests before using them as competitor status claims.
mobileRemainder.why_remaining: Official docs now give present-day feature/fix context, but do not document exact Android project/task search picker flow; historic community reports remain historical evidence only.
mobileRemainder.ready_when: Only current official documentation or hands-on result is used for present-day competitor functionality; historic pain remains clearly dated.
mobileRemainder.status: Documentary current-state check completed on 2026-10-11 using complete relevant sections of current official help pages and relevant changelog entries; hands-on Android verification remains separate and explicitly not claimed.

mobileRemainder.task: Check that a seed translation update does not overwrite custom user labels and synonyms.
mobileRemainder.why_remaining: Current core supports some effective-field preservation but has no verified provenance/overlay adapter or actual catalog update migration test.
mobileRemainder.ready_when: A seeded catalog update preserves stable IDs, user labels, aliases, favorites, history mappings, and allows rollback/undo.
mobileRemainder.status: Source-vs-user alias/override policy proposed; seed translation refresh remains untested.

mobileRemainder.task: Decide whether recents have a visible cap, whether frequent-use ranking is offered, and its period if so.
mobileRemainder.why_remaining: Spec now offers a reversible starting point, but the optimum count/window and rank remain hypotheses.
mobileRemainder.ready_when: A prototype test records discovery and start speed across a small/medium/large library with recent and favorites separated.
mobileRemainder.status: Provisional cap/order specified for test (eight recent unique launch items plus All); keep open until user/device evidence supports or changes it.
